caseNameFull: Miles Edward Haynes v. United States
attorneys: Charles Alan Wright for petitioner., Solicitor General Marshall, Assistant Attorney General Vinson, Beatrice Rosenberg and Kirby W. Patterson for the United States.

opinions.text: C. A. 5th Cir. Motion for leave to proceed m forma pauperis and petition for writ of certiorari granted. Case transferred to appellate docket and set for oral argument immediately following No. 181.
